findings.evidence: A form with a Submit button labeled 'Save' for the digest frequency field has no specified result state.
findings.fix: Specify what screen or state the user sees after clicking Save - either return to the prior screen, a success confirmation, or an updated view showing the selected frequency.
findings.violation: The user has no indication of whether the preference change was saved successfully.

findings.evidence: A form with a Submit button labeled 'Save' for the project name field has no specified result: no next screen, no success message, no confirmation of state change.
findings.fix: Specify what screen or state the user sees after clicking Save - either a success confirmation and return to project-settings, or an updated project-settings view with the new name displayed.
findings.violation: The user has no indication of whether the save action succeeded, what the resulting state is, or what to do next.

findings.evidence: A button with aria-label='Duplicate project' is specified, but the artifact does not define what screen or state results from clicking it.
findings.fix: Specify the outcome of clicking Duplicate - whether it creates a copy with a modified name, shows a confirmation dialog, or transitions to another state where the user can confirm the duplication.
findings.violation: The user cannot predict what will happen when they click the Duplicate button.

findings.evidence: The archive-confirm section states 'You can restore it at any time from the archived projects list,' but the artifact contains no screen for viewing archived projects or accessing a restore control.
findings.fix: Add a screen showing archived projects with a restore control, and link to it from the project-archived confirmation or from project-settings.
findings.violation: A reversible action describes the possibility of reversal but provides no interface in the artifact to perform it.

findings.evidence: The invite-sent confirmation states 'An invite was sent to the address entered above,' but does not display the email address itself.
findings.fix: Display the email address on the invite-sent confirmation screen so the user can verify it without going back.
findings.violation: Information needed at this step - the email address that received the invite - is not available on the screen.
